environment.description: Same EKS cluster but the namespace has a Cilium-enforced L3/L4 NetworkPolicy. The policy spec uses a combination of egress rules: it allows DNS resolution to kube-dns (UDP/53) and permits egress only to the cluster CIDR 10.96.0.0/12 and the pod CIDR 10.244.0.0/16. There is NO explicit allowance for the link-local range. Cilium's default-deny posture for the namespace means any egress to 169.254.0.0/16 is dropped at the eBPF datapath level before the packet leaves the pod's veth pair. The policy was applied via a CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD with endpointSelector matching label app=credential-service. Note: the health_check endpoint still has the potential slice panic on short access_key strings, and the SSRF code path still exists in the binary.
